🛡️ Moosewood Drive Sanctuary • Virginia Beach

Hi, I’m Jessica—Welcome Under Our Roof.

Every novel, every song, every branching adventure, and every room across RaggieSoft is 100% my younger brother Michael’s idea and handiwork. Back in November 2006, I helped get him out from under an abuser’s roof, put a real creative desk in front of him, and provided the seed money so nobody could ever stand in his way again.

“Michael (‘Bear’) is our primary builder. I’m the big sister keeping the house steady so nothing ever breaks—and our little sister Rachel (‘Bug’) sits right beside him as his quality tester.”
Take Jessica’s Tour of RaggieSoftRead the November 2006 Seed StoryMeet Bear & His QA Bug

One Dreamer, One Big Sister, and One Eagle-Eyed Bug

Here is how the three of us from The Rachel Narrative divide the house so Michael’s stories and music reach you without a single corporate middleman.

100% His Vision • Primary Builder

Michael Ragsdale — “Bear”

Every novel, every song lyric, every melody, and every room across RaggieSoft started in Michael’s head and was built by his own two hands. Nobody ghostwrites for him, and nobody tells him shrink his imagination.

“People sometimes assume a big studio team dreamed all of this up. Nope—every single world under this roof is 100% my brother’s brainchild. I just made sure he finally had a quiet desk where nobody could take it away from him.”
Read Michael’s Story in The Rachel Narrative
November 2006 Rescue • Seed Backer • Keeps Everything Running

Jessica Marie Ragsdale — “Big Sister & Keeper of the House”

From my manual wheelchair in Seattle to our home base in Virginia Beach, my job has always been simple: get my brother out of harm’s way, put up the seed money so his studio stands independent, and keep the lights steady around the clock so nothing ever breaks.

“You are standing on my porch right now! Every page you open across RaggieSoft lives under my roof. While Michael dreams up new chapters and songs, I watch the storm doors so everything opens fast, clean, and safe.”
Read The Quantum Directive: Jessica’s Cut
Bear’s Co-Pilot • Lead Quality Tester

Rachel Ragsdale — “Bug”

Where you find Bear, you always find his Bug. Rachel pulls her chair right up beside Michael’s desk, reads every chapter out loud, clicks every branching story choice, checks every timed song lyric, and catches every tiny rough edge before you ever visit.

“Rachel has been fiercely guarding Michael’s heart since they were eight and ten years old. Nothing goes out our front door until Bug gives it her stamp of approval—and gives her brother one of their Bear-and-Bug hugs.”
Meet Bear & Bug on RaggieSoft Book Reader

The Personal Story Behind Every RaggieSoft Project

Want to know why my brother dreamed up each book imprint, band, interactive world, and desktop app? Read the story behind every project below—or visit The Uncharted Waystation (Global Directory) anytime you just want our quick A–Z portal map!

Front Door & Guidesraggiesoft.com

🌐 RaggieSoft Front Porch (Main Homepage)

Why Michael wanted a calm, uncluttered front door instead of a noisy portal. Think of raggiesoft.com as the front foyer of our house. Michael intentionally kept it focused on four welcoming pillars—reading, music, desktop apps, and open-culture sharing—so first-time visitors never feel overwhelmed before stepping into our Global Directory or story rooms.

🐞 Rachel’s (“Bug’s”) QA Note: Rachel checks every seasonal tribute banner and welcome card on both phone and desktop screens.
Visit raggiesoft.com →
Front Door & Guideslauncher.raggiesoft.com

🚀 RaggieSoft Launcher (Desktop App Home)

Why Michael built an account-free desktop home that respects your computer. Modern app launchers drive all three of us crazy with forced accounts, pop-ups, and background bloat. So Michael built RaggieSoft Launcher to unite Book Reader, The Listening Room, Backstage, and StoreTrainer in one quiet window—opening only when you ask, offering Express or Custom setup, and never deleting your offline books, albums, or saved game profiles.

🐞 Rachel’s (“Bug’s”) QA Note: Rachel tested Express Setup, Custom Setup, and every uninstaller checkbox to prove your offline files stay untouched!

Front Door & Guidesstoretrainer.raggiesoft.com

💾 RaggieSoft StoreTrainer (From Childhood PC Utility to 2.0)

The story behind Michael’s earliest surviving desktop program and its modern rebirth. Long before today’s novels and albums, Michael built StoreTrainer on classic desktop Windows to launch favorite PC games alongside their companion trainers without juggling folders. Rather than letting that history collect dust, he preserved the original retro edition for vintage PCs AND built StoreTrainer 2.0 with a gentle upgrade wizard that carries old game profiles forward.

🐞 Rachel’s (“Bug’s”) QA Note: Rachel grew up watching Michael tinker on those childhood machines—and now tests the floating Cheat Card beside him!
Visit storetrainer.raggiesoft.com →
Front Door & Guidesa11y.raggiesoft.com

♿ RaggieSoft Accessibility Studio (From University Batch Tool to Full Studio)

How a self-started Old Dominion University helper grew into a full desktop studio. When Michael worked at Old Dominion University helping move hundreds of online classes from ODU’s custom Personal Learning Environment (PLE) into Canvas, nobody asked him to write desktop software—he just saw teammates spending hours checking course pages one by one and quietly built a polite batch-scanning utility on his own initiative. Years later at our Virginia Beach desk, watching me navigate from my wheelchair and watching Rachel test every page by keyboard inspired him to turn that seed idea into RaggieSoft Accessibility Studio: a full Windows workstation studio where builders can see issues side-by-side and fix them cleanly.

🐞 Rachel’s (“Bug’s”) QA Note: Rachel unplugs the mouse and tests every single keyboard shortcut and high-contrast preview right beside her Bear!
Visit a11y.raggiesoft.com →
